# Infrastructure

OpenTofu configuration for the deployed service. One MCP service runs per environment (see [ADR-001](../adr/ADR-001-one-mcp-service-per-environment.md)). Environment values live in `infra/environments/`, not here.

## Root stack (`infra/`)

One instance per environment, selected with `environments/<env>.tfvars` and `environments/<env>-backend.hcl`. Composes the shared and per-environment service modules.

### Requirements

| Name | Version |
| ---- | ------- |
| terraform | >= 1.6 |
| aws | ~> 5.70 |

### Modules

| Name | Source | Version |
| ---- | ------ | ------- |
| service | ./modules/mcp-service | n/a |
| shared | ./modules/mcp-shared | n/a |

### Resources

| Name | Type |
| ---- | ---- |
| [aws_acm_certificate.mcp](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/hashicorp/aws/latest/docs/data-sources/acm_certificate) | data source |
| [aws_security_group.dspace_ecs_service](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/hashicorp/aws/latest/docs/data-sources/security_group) | data source |
| [aws_security_group.dspace_solr](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/hashicorp/aws/latest/docs/data-sources/security_group) | data source |
| [aws_sns_topic.alerts](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/hashicorp/aws/latest/docs/data-sources/sns_topic) | data source |
| [terraform_remote_state.dspace](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/hashicorp/terraform/latest/docs/data-sources/remote_state) | data source |

### Inputs

| Name | Description | Type | Default | Required |
| ---- | ----------- | ---- | ------- | :------: |
| environment | Deployment environment: stage or prod. | `string` | n/a | yes |
| jscholarship\_public\_url | JScholarship public base URL for this environment. | `string` | n/a | yes |
| prod\_hostname | Public hostname for the production MCP endpoint. | `string` | n/a | yes |
| stage\_hostname | Public hostname for the stage MCP endpoint. | `string` | n/a | yes |
| aws\_region | AWS region. | `string` | `"us-east-1"` | no |
| capacity\_provider | Fargate capacity provider: FARGATE or FARGATE\_SPOT. | `string` | `"FARGATE"` | no |
| dataverse\_api\_sg\_id | Dataverse API security group ID. Null disables Dataverse SG rules. | `string` | `null` | no |
| dataverse\_solr\_sg\_id | Dataverse Solr security group ID. Null disables Dataverse SG rules. | `string` | `null` | no |
| jhrdr\_api\_url | Dataverse API URL. Empty string disables. | `string` | `""` | no |
| jhrdr\_public\_url | JHRDR public base URL. Empty string disables. | `string` | `""` | no |
| jhrdr\_solr\_url | JHRDR Solr URL. Empty string disables. | `string` | `""` | no |
| log\_retention\_days | CloudWatch log retention in days. | `number` | `90` | no |
| service\_desired\_count | Initial task count. | `number` | `1` | no |
| service\_max\_count | Max task count for autoscaling. | `number` | `2` | no |
| service\_min\_count | Min task count for autoscaling. | `number` | `1` | no |
| tags | Common resource tags. | `map(string)` | `{}` | no |
| task\_cpu | Fargate task CPU units. | `number` | `512` | no |
| task\_memory | Fargate task memory (MiB). | `number` | `1024` | no |
| waf\_rate\_limit | WAF rate limit per 5-minute window per IP. | `number` | `300` | no |

### Outputs

| Name | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| alb\_dns\_name | ALB DNS name (for CNAME or Cloudflare proxy). |
| alb\_zone\_id | ALB Route 53 zone ID. |
| ecr\_repository\_url | ECR repository URL for CI/CD image pushes. |
| ecs\_cluster\_name | Shared MCP ECS cluster name. |
| ecs\_service\_name | ECS service name for this environment. |
| service\_endpoint | MCP public endpoint for this environment. |
| task\_sg\_id | Task security group ID for this environment. |

## Shared module (`infra/modules/mcp-shared`)
